title: Woman dies at Winnipeg detox centre
article: Police in Winnipeg have released the name of the woman who died Monday morningafter being taken toa city detoxification centre.
Cheryl Lynn Coughlan, 35, was arrested about 7 a.m. Monday after causing a disturbance at a Westwood-area convenience store.
She was taken to the Main Street Project's detoxification detention centre on Martha Street. At about 9:40 a.m., staff doing a routine check found her unresponsive.
She was sent to a hospital in critical condition, where she died.
Police have not commented on the cause of death, but said the homicide unit is investigating.
